svg.title: Survival
svg.desc: Kaplan–Meier plot with two stepped survival curves, censor ticks, axes, legend, and risk-table hint. Biological basis: Kaplan–Meier estimates change only at events; censor marks identify observations whose subsequent survival time is unknown.
